name: Bumper Bracket (v2.1)
description: A 3D-printed bracket that mounts to the kneeler bracket plate, providing a structured shell envelope (core, roof wedge, and pew mount pad) with #8 wood-screw bores through the roof wedge. v2.1 splits the tread-side carriage into a separate print for easier bed placement. Sold in mirrored left and right pairs.

printSettings.bracketShell: PLA or PETG | 4 Wall Loops | 40% Infill
printSettings.treadCarriage: PLA or PETG | 4 Wall Loops | 40% Infill

assemblyGuide: Select the correct side: left or right — they are mirror images of each other.
Print the matching tread carriage for each bracket shell.
Mate the tread carriage into the bracket shell before installation.
Align the bumper bracket over the kneeler bracket plate, engaging the pew mount pad against the pew.
Drive #8 wood screws through the roof wedge bores to secure the bracket.
Verify the tread slot opens toward the kneeler tread side and the part seats flush.
